“Oh, come on! There was never any choice…!”

If I climb the hill—if I follow that giant—I will die.

I force down the terror shuddering through my back and sprint up the slope with everything I have.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Man, there’s nothing else I can do…!!”
I’ll be killed if I go up the hill after that giant.
My body is trembling from that fact, but I suppress it and run up the slope.

“Saber—!”

I burst into the wasteland.

…And find something utterly unlike what I expected.

Each time the roaring giant sweeps his greatsword, monuments too heavy to move are split apart as though they were toys.
